evidence: The TMP (Sigma-Aldrich, 97%) and TTIP (Sigma-Aldrich, 97%) precursor bottles were heated up to 45 ◦C and 60 ◦C, while manually adjustable needle valves were installed to control the pressure of nitrogen gas and oxygen gas at a value of approximately 5 ∗ 10 −3 mbar. The plasma power was selected to be 200 W for nitrogen gas, TMP and DEPA, while the oxygen gas was pulsed as a 300 W plasma.
